currentParagraphText: “I never said they were,” Jake protested.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I never said they were,” Jake protested.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “You kind of are,” Caleb said in a sharp tone. “Do they fully understand everything being the World Leader and Chosen of the Malefic Viper entails? No, but they understand that the two of us – especially you – aren’t regular people by any metric. You, especially, are a multiversal entity at this point and undoubtedly the most influential person in the entire galaxy, if not the universe. Think a little. Do you know why they never bug you about not calling? Why they don’t complain when you don’t visit? Because they don’t want to burden you. They don’t want to impede your Path in any way... and the best way of doing that is to stay out of your life and only have you engage on your own terms. It’s their way of helping, no matter how small or insignificant it seems.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “They know, Jake,” Caleb sighed and shook his head. “Of course, they know. Mom and Dad aren’t stupid.”
